name: json-to-express
description: Generate runnable Express REST APIs from declarative JSON for MongoDB/Mongoose or PostgreSQL/Prisma.

scripts.validate:examples: node bin/json-to-express.js validate examples/shop.json && node bin/json-to-express.js validate examples/e2e.json && node bin/json-to-express.js validate examples/e2e-postgres.json && node bin/json-to-express.js validate examples/e2e-s3.json
